_comment: Spoiler-safe character sheet. firstSeen/at are seconds. Timestamps are APPROXIMATE: verify by watching before the demo. 'reveals' are appended only after their time.

characters.name: Sintel
characters.description: A determined young woman with a short sword, travelling alone through the snowy mountains.

characters.name: The Shaman
characters.description: An old hermit who finds Sintel half-frozen and gives her shelter in his hut.

characters.name: Scales
characters.description: A wounded baby dragon Sintel rescued in a city alley and nursed back to health. She named him Scales.

reveals.text: A grown dragon swooped down and carried Scales away, which is why Sintel is searching.

characters.name: The adult dragon
characters.description: A huge dragon that took Scales. Sintel is tracking it to its lair in the mountains.

reveals.text: Sintel finally confronts it in its lair.
